nusmp.page.book_bone.bone_sprout: Bone Sprout - bones sprout from the ground in a straight row ahead of you and throw the foes standing on it into the air. A 6-block line: up to 4 foes take a starter hit and are lifted.
nusmp.page.book_bone.bone_blade: Bone Blade - the user shapes a bone into a sword and cuts a wide arc in front of them (the wiki: bones can be shaped into weapons like swords). A 3.5-block cone: up to 4 foes take a starter hit.
nusmp.page.book_bone.branching_bone: Branching Bone - the bone splits and branches into several sharpened points that fly out in a fan (the wiki: bones branch in multiple directions and end in points). Four bone points, about 1.2 starter hits shared between them.
nusmp.page.book_bone.bone_thicket: Bone Thicket - a bed of short bone spikes grows where you aim and cuts and slows whoever crosses it. A 3.5-block field for 3 seconds: a small hit every 0.6 seconds and slowness.
nusmp.page.book_bone.bone_extension: Extending Bone - a bone grows out of the hand to a great length and runs the foes in front of you through (the wiki: bones can extend to great lengths). A 14-block line: up to 6 foes take a mid hit and are knocked back.
nusmp.page.book_bone.bone_wall: Ossuary Wall - a wall of fused bone rises in front of you and crumbles again after 8 seconds. A 4 wide, 3 high wall of temporary bone blocks; nothing is damaged.
nusmp.page.book_bone.splinter_burst: Splinter Burst - bones burst out of the body in every direction in a ring of splinters. A 4.5-block ring around you: up to 6 foes take a mid hit, are thrown back and slowed.
nusmp.page.book_bone.bone_regrowth: Bone Regrowth - the user's own bone grows back over torn flesh and mends the wound (the wiki: with Soul, Body and Blood Magic bone gives recovery far beyond Healing Magic; here the bone alone gives a smaller version). Heals 30 percent of your health.
nusmp.page.book_bone.bone_forest: Bone Forest - a stand of tall bones grows where you aim and spears whatever is inside it. A 5-block field for 5 seconds: a zone hit every half second to up to 8 foes, each lifted a little.
nusmp.page.book_bone.bone_cage: Bone Cage - ribs of bone close around the foes at the aim point and hold them in place. A 5-block burst where you aim: up to 8 foes take a zone hit and are slowed heavily for 5 seconds.
nusmp.page.book_bone.thousand_bone_grave: Thousand Bone Grave - a mound of bone erupts where you aim, over and over, and buries everything inside it. A 7-block field for 5 seconds: up to 10 foes take a heavy pulse every half second and are slowed.
nusmp.page.book_dark.dark_cloaked_afteri: Dark Cloaked Afterimage - Yami blurs forward in a straight cut and leaves a black afterimage behind (an extension page after the Iai Slash). You dash up to 6 blocks and hit up to 4 foes on the way.
nusmp.page.book_dark.umbral_lance: Umbral Lance - a thrown spear of darkness that slows the foe it pierces (an extension page after Death Thrust). One bolt: a starter hit and slowness for 2 seconds.
nusmp.page.book_dark.gloom_cloak: Gloom Cloak - darkness wraps the body and makes it quick and hard to hit in the dim. For 10 seconds you are faster and your melee hits deal a little extra.
nusmp.page.book_dark.void_snare: Void Snare - a tiny black hole closes round the foe you look at and holds it for a moment (a small cousin of Black Hole). One target within 14 blocks takes a small hit and is held slow.
nusmp.page.book_dark.dark_cloaked_crossi: Dark Cloaked Crossing Slash - a flurry of crossed cuts of darkness in a wide arc (a tamer sister of the Avidya Wild Slash). A 5-block cone: up to 6 foes take a mid hit.
nusmp.page.book_dark.midnight_wave: Midnight Wave - a wide crescent of darkness sweeps down a long lane and shoves the foes in it back. A 14-block lane: up to 6 foes take a mid hit and are knocked back.
nusmp.page.book_dark.devouring_shade: Devouring Shade - the shadow of the blade swallows the magic on the foes in front of you, as the Avidya Slash swallows spells, and feeds you a little. A 6-block cone: up to 6 foes lose one beneficial effect and you heal for each hit.
nusmp.page.book_dark.crescent_barrage: Dark Cloaked Crescent Barrage - five blades of darkness seek the nearest foes. About 1.2 mid hits shared between the five blades.
nusmp.page.book_dark.abyssal_pit: Abyssal Pit - the ground at the aim point turns to a pit of darkness that drags at everything inside. A 5-block field for 4 seconds: a zone hit every half second to up to 8 foes and slowness.
nusmp.page.book_dark.eclipse_fall: Eclipse Fall - a dark moon drops on the aim point and blots out the light of everyone beneath it. A 6-block burst where you aim: up to 8 foes take a zone hit and are plunged into darkness for 5 seconds.
nusmp.page.book_dark.avidya_blunt_strike: Dark Cloaked Avidya Blunt Strike - Yami strikes with the dull back of the darkness-coated blade, a blow that knocks the wind out of the foe instead of cutting. A 3.5-block cone: a starter hit, strong knockback and a short daze.
nusmp.page.book_dark.black_cocoon: Dark Cloaked Black Cocoon - Yami wraps himself in a shell of darkness against an attack of Light Magic. For 5 seconds you take far less damage and have two hearts of absorption.
nusmp.page.book_dark.dusk: Dark Cloaked Dusk - the light fails around Yami and the foes lose sight of him. Foes within 7 blocks are plunged into darkness and slowed, and you move faster for 5 seconds.
nusmp.page.book_dark.black_blade_shadow_: Black Blade Shadow Strike - Yami slips into the foe's shadow and cuts from behind with the lengthened black blade. You blink behind the target you look at and hit up to 6 foes on the way.
nusmp.page.book_shadow.shadow_needles: Shadow Needles - needles of shadow shoot out of the user's own shadow. Three needles in a fan share about 1.2 starter hits.
nusmp.page.book_shadow.grasping_hands: Grasping Hands - hands of shadow rise from the foe's own shadow and hold it, as they do in the Dark Garden Invitation. One target within 14 blocks takes a small hit and is held slow.
nusmp.page.book_shadow.shadow_slip: Shadow Slip - the user sinks into their own shadow and rises a few steps ahead (a short cousin of the Shadow Corridor). You move up to 8 blocks forward; nothing is hit.
nusmp.page.book_shadow.umbral_shroud: Umbral Shroud - shadow clothes the user like a ninja's garb and hides them from sight. For 8 seconds you are invisible and quicker, and your melee hits deal a little extra.
nusmp.page.book_shadow.doppelganger: Doppelganger - the user slips into a shadow and comes out behind the foe, striking as one with a mirrored cut. You blink behind the target you look at and hit up to 6 foes on the way.
nusmp.page.book_shadow.shadow_eruption: Shadow Eruption - a pool of shadow opens under the user and throws everything near up in a burst of black hands. A 4.5-block ring: up to 6 foes take a mid hit and are lifted.
nusmp.page.book_shadow.veil_of_night: Veil of Night - a sheet of night is thrown over the foes in front of the user and blinds them. A 7-block cone: up to 6 foes take a mid hit and are blinded for 3 seconds.
nusmp.page.book_shadow.shadow_double: Shadow Double - a double of shadow draws the eyes of the hunters while the user melts away. Mobs that hunt you within 16 blocks lose you and you turn invisible for 3 seconds.
nusmp.page.book_shadow.unite_canis_equus: Unite Mode: Canis x Equus - Nacht takes Gimodelo and Slotos into himself at once and his power leaps to a high devil's. For 15 seconds you are stronger and tougher, your melee hits deal extra and strike back at attackers.
nusmp.page.book_shadow.endless_night: Endless Night - the night spreads over the aim point and does not lift. A 6-block field for 5 seconds: a zone hit every half second to up to 8 foes, who are weakened and kept in darkness.
nusmp.page.book_shadow.shadow_prison: Shadow Prison - the shadows of the foes at the aim point turn solid and pin them where they stand. A 5-block burst: up to 8 foes take a zone hit and are slowed to a crawl for 5 seconds.
nusmp.page.book_shadow.walpurgis_night: Walpurgis Night - Nacht joins all four devils with the two Dark Magic users and the shadows rise as one. A 8-block field around you for 5 seconds: up to 10 foes take a heavy pulse every half second and are slowed.
nusmp.page.book_ash.ash_lash: Ash Lash - a whip of ash cracks down a lane and leaves the foes withering. An 8-block lane: up to 4 foes take a starter hit and wither for 3 seconds.
nusmp.page.book_ash.pitfall_trap: Pitfall Trap - Zora draws an ash circle where the foe will step and the ground gives way under it. An ash trap lies at the aim point for 5 seconds: the first foe to step within 2 blocks springs it, and up to 4 foes within 2.5 blocks take a starter hit and are rooted.
nusmp.page.book_ash.ash_step: Ash Step - the user turns to a puff of ash and drifts a few steps ahead. You move up to 8 blocks forward; nothing is hit.
nusmp.page.book_ash.mine_trap: Mine Trap - a circle of ash that bursts when it is stepped on. An ash mine lies at the aim point for 5 seconds: the first foe within 1.8 blocks springs it and up to 6 foes within 3.5 blocks take a mid hit and are thrown back.
nusmp.page.book_ash.smothering_ash: Smothering Ash - a heavy cloud of ash is blown into the foes' faces. A 6-block cone: up to 6 foes take a mid hit and are blinded and slowed for 3 seconds.
nusmp.page.book_ash.ash_barricade: Ash Barricade - ash packs into a dark wall in front of you and blows away again after 8 seconds. A 4 wide, 3 high wall of temporary blocks; nothing is damaged.
nusmp.page.book_ash.cinder_rain: Cinder Rain - glowing cinders from the ash fall in a spray (Ash Magic is derived from Flame). Five cinders in a fan share about 1.2 mid hits and set the foes alight for 2 seconds.
nusmp.page.book_ash.smoldering_ground: Smoldering Ground - the ground at the aim point turns to hot ash that withers whatever stands on it. A 5-block field for 5 seconds: a zone hit every half second to up to 8 foes, who wither.
nusmp.page.book_ash.ash_sentinels: Ash Sentinels - ash rises into guards round the user and strikes whatever steps close. A 3.5-block field that follows you for 5 seconds: up to 8 foes in it take a zone hit every half second and are pushed off.
nusmp.page.book_ash.ash_storm: Ash Storm - the ash round the user whirls up into one great gust. A 6-block ring around you: up to 8 foes take a zone hit, are thrown back and are blinded for 3 seconds.
nusmp.page.book_blood.jets_of_blood: Jets of Blood - the user releases high-pressure streams of blood from the body (the wiki: they can also speed up projectiles). A 9-block lane: up to 4 foes take a starter hit and are pushed back.
nusmp.page.book_blood.blood_spikes: Blood Spikes - blood hardens into spikes that skewer the foes in front of you (Vanica skewers Charlotte's limbs with spikes of blood in the manga, but the series gives the move no name). A 7-block lane: up to 4 foes take a starter hit.
nusmp.page.book_blood.blood_surge: Blood Surge - the user rides a rush of their own blood forward and drinks a little from what they cut. You dash up to 7 blocks, hit up to 4 foes on the way and heal a little for each.
nusmp.page.book_blood.scaffold_of_fresh_: Scaffold of Fresh Blood - a flood of blood soaks the ground and crosses of blood rise and hold whoever stands there. A 4-block burst where you aim: up to 6 foes take a mid hit and are held almost still for 5 seconds.
nusmp.page.book_blood.puppet_bloodflow: Puppet Bloodflow - the user takes hold of the blood in the foe's own body and steers it like a puppet. One target within 16 blocks takes a hit and is held slow.
nusmp.page.book_blood.curse_breaking_blo: Curse-Breaking Blood Cocoon - veins of blood wrap the wounded part in a dark orb, heal it and strengthen the body (the wiki). You heal 25 percent of your health and every harmful effect on you is lifted.
nusmp.page.book_blood.lifeblood_scythe: Lifeblood Scythe - the user shapes a great deal of blood into a giant scythe and swings it by hand (the wiki, Blood Creation Magic). A 5-block half-circle sweep: up to 6 foes take a mid hit and you heal a little for each.
nusmp.page.book_blood.blood_frenzy: Blood Frenzy - the blood runs hot and the body moves past its limit. For 12 seconds you are stronger and faster and your melee hits deal extra.
nusmp.page.book_blood.thorn_sigil: Crimson Thorn Sigil - a sigil of blood is drawn on the ground and thorns rise from it again and again (the picture of Vanica's blood sigil). A 5-block field for 4 seconds: a zone hit every half second to up to 8 foes, and you heal a little for each hit.
nusmp.page.book_blood.sanguine_eruption: Sanguine Eruption - blood bursts up out of the ground at the aim point like a geyser. A 5-block burst where you aim: up to 8 foes take a zone hit, are thrown up and back.
nusmp.page.book_light.photon_lance: Photon Lance - a needle of light thrown in one flash (the fast, thin cousin of the Light Sword of Judgment). One bolt: a starter hit that ends in a flash.
nusmp.page.book_light.radiant_flare: Radiant Flare - the user bursts into a flash too bright to look at. A 5-block ring around you: up to 4 foes take a starter hit and are blinded for 2 seconds.
nusmp.page.book_light.radiant_ward: Radiant Ward - a skin of light closes round the user and takes the force out of blows. For 6 seconds you take much less damage and have two hearts of absorption.
nusmp.page.book_light.dawn_beam: Dawn Beam - a straight beam of light across the field at the speed of light. An 18-block beam: up to 6 foes on it take a mid hit.
nusmp.page.book_light.protecting_light: Demon-Dweller Sword: Protecting Light - Light Magic is passed through the sword to the allies, who are quickened and shielded. You and up to 5 allies within 8 blocks get speed and damage resistance for 8 seconds.
nusmp.page.book_light.storm_of_light_imp: Storm of Light Imperial Swords of Conviction - a rain of light swords that find their foes (Patolli with Drowa's mirrors). Five homing swords share about 1.2 zone hits.
nusmp.page.book_light.quintet_sword_of_j: Light Magic: Elemental Quintet - a giant Light Sword of Judgment is launched while the streams of four other magics swirl round it (the wiki; the other four mages are not needed here). A 22-block, wide lane: up to 10 foes take a heavy hit and are thrown back.
nusmp.page.book_light.karna_gibbous_ray: Moonlight Magic: Gibbous Ray - a swelling ray of moonlight that bursts where it lands. One bolt that bursts in a 4-block ball: up to 6 foes take a mid hit.
nusmp.page.book_light.karna_moon_trap: Moonlight Magic: Moon Trap - a circle of moonlight lies in wait and snaps shut on whoever steps in. A moon trap lies at the aim point for 5 seconds: the first foe within 2 blocks springs it and up to 6 foes within 3.5 blocks take a mid hit and are held slow.
nusmp.page.book_curse.hex_needle: Hex Needle - a needle of curse that saps the strength of what it pricks (the wiki: curse magic adds lasting negative effects). One bolt: a starter hit and weakness for 5 seconds.
nusmp.page.book_curse.wasting_touch: Wasting Touch - a curse laid on at arm's length that wastes the body and the appetite. A short 3-block cone: up to 4 foes take a starter hit, wither for 4 seconds and go hungry.
nusmp.page.book_curse.jinx: Jinx - ill luck is hung on the foes at the aim point (the dulled senses and misfortune of the wiki's curses). A 3-block burst where you aim: up to 4 foes take a starter hit, are unlucky for 10 seconds and stumble.
nusmp.page.book_curse.plague_wind: Plague Wind - a wind of sickness blown over the foes in front of you (the wiki: curses range from dulled senses to debilitating sickness). An 8-block cone: up to 6 foes take a mid hit and are poisoned and weakened for 5 seconds.
nusmp.page.book_curse.effigy_curse: Effigy Curse - a doll takes the foe's name and whatever is done to it, the foe feels. One target within 16 blocks takes a hit, is held slow and is weakened for 6 seconds.
nusmp.page.book_curse.hex_swarm: Hex Swarm - a swarm of small curses homes in on the nearest foes. Five homing hexes share about 1.2 mid hits and poison for 3 seconds.
nusmp.page.book_curse.rotting_ground: Rotting Ground - the ground at the aim point is cursed and eats whatever stands on it. A 5-block field for 5 seconds: a zone hit every half second to up to 8 foes, who wither.
nusmp.page.book_curse_warding.spell_seve: Spell-Severing Curse - a curse that cuts the magic off a foe (the wiki: curses can weaken and disable enemy spells). One bolt: a starter hit, one beneficial effect stripped and weakness for 4 seconds.
nusmp.page.book_curse_warding.quickening: Quickening Curse - a beneficial curse laid on oneself that mends the body at speed (the wiki: curses can give high-speed regeneration). For 8 seconds you regenerate quickly and your melee hits deal extra.
nusmp.page.book_curse_warding.detonation: Detonation Hex - a curse that makes the power inside the foes burst (the wiki: curses can detonate a person's magic power; Exploding Life is the great form). A 3.5-block burst where you aim: up to 6 foes take a mid hit and are thrown back.
nusmp.page.book_curse_warding.rune_field: Rune Field - warding runes are laid over the aim point and burn whoever walks them. A 5-block field for 5 seconds: a zone hit every half second to up to 8 foes and slowness.
nusmp.page.book_demon_light.black_light_: Black Light Ray - a thin beam of black light, faster and denser than its Light Magic counterpart (the wiki). A 16-block beam: up to 4 foes take a starter hit.
nusmp.page.book_demon_light.demon_arrows: Demon Light Magic: Arrows of Judgment - the black-light form of the Light Magic spell of blades that rain on the target (the spell is Light Magic's on the wiki; the black version is this mod's). Five homing arrows share about 1.2 mid hits.
nusmp.page.book_demon_light.demon_heaven: Demon Light Magic: Heaven-Splitting Flash - the black-light form of the Light Magic flash that splits the sky (the spell is Light Magic's on the wiki; the black version is this mod's). A 6-block burst where you aim: up to 8 foes take a zone hit and are blinded for 3 seconds.
nusmp.page.book_anti_magic.dispelling_th: Dispelling Thrust - a short thrust of the demon sword that tears the magic off what it hits. A 3.5-block cone with a greatsword in hand: up to 4 foes take a starter hit and lose one beneficial effect.
nusmp.page.book_anti_magic.black_sweep: Black Sweep - one wide flat swing of the demon sword that clears the space round Asta. A 5-block half-circle with a greatsword in hand: up to 4 foes take a starter hit and are knocked back.
nusmp.page.book_anti_magic.black_guard: Black Guard - Asta holds the blade across his body and cuts whatever magic flies at him. Projectiles within 4.5 blocks that are not yours are cut down and you take much less damage for 2.5 seconds.
nusmp.page.book_anti_magic.causality_bre: Demon-Destroyer Sword: Causality Break - the sword's tendrils cut the link between a spell and its effects, so the effect is undone. Every harmful effect on you is lifted and up to 6 foes in the 6-block cone lose a beneficial effect and take a hit.
nusmp.page.book_anti_magic.black_slash_b: Black Slash Barrage - the Black Slash fired five times in a fan. About 1.2 mid hits shared by five slashes; needs a greatsword in hand.
nusmp.page.book_anti_magic.dweller_fligh: Demon-Dweller Sword: Flight - Asta rides the light Demon-Dweller Sword on his Anti-Magic and shoots forward. You move up to 12 blocks forward; nothing is hit.
nusmp.page.book_anti_magic.magic_negatin: Magic-Negating Barrier - a dome of Anti-Magic that cancels what the enemy throws at it (the wiki: the Demon-Destroyer Sword makes a barrier that negates Atmosphere Magic). For 4 seconds every projectile within 5 blocks that is not yours is cut down and you take less damage.
nusmp.page.forbidden_magic.devils_claw: Devil's Claw - the devil's own claw rakes out of the dark and the wounds do not close. A 4.5-block cone: up to 4 foes take a starter hit and wither for 3 seconds. Pays the forbidden price (health) and announces itself.
nusmp.page.forbidden_magic.contract_bolt: Contract Bolt - the written contract flares and flies as a bolt of hellfire. One bolt that bursts in a 2.5-block ball: a starter hit and 3 seconds of fire. Pays the forbidden price and announces itself.
nusmp.page.forbidden_magic.soul_siphon: Soul Siphon - a thread is pulled from the foes' souls into the devil's host and pays back part of the price. A 10-block lane: up to 6 foes take a mid hit and you heal for each. Pays the forbidden price and announces itself.
nusmp.page.forbidden_magic.devils_bargai: Devil's Bargain - power now, paid for in blood: the devil lends its strength for a short time. For 10 seconds you are much stronger and faster and your melee hits deal extra. Pays the forbidden price and announces itself.
nusmp.page.forbidden_magic.damned_cry: Cry of the Damned - a scream from the underworld that throws back everything near and saps it. A 5-block ring around you: up to 6 foes take a mid hit, are thrown back and weakened for 4 seconds. Pays the forbidden price and announces itself.
nusmp.page.forbidden_magic.condemned_vol: Condemned Volley - four dark marks of the contract hunt down their foes. Four homing marks share about 1.2 mid hits. Pays the forbidden price and announces itself.
nusmp.page.forbidden_magic.abyssal_chain: Abyssal Chains - chains from the pit close on whatever stands at the aim point. A 5-block field for 5 seconds: a zone hit every half second to up to 8 foes and slowness. Pays the forbidden price and announces itself.
